newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to be confined to 130.20-60.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to be confined to 130.20-60.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF will trade sideways on Friday within a range between 130.20 and 130.60, techncial analysts said.
"There are not too many influences on the market and the techncials are mixed," said Jim Dodgin, senior technical analyst at Technical Data in London.
"We are likely to trade sideways for today...within a range similar to Thursday."
At 0742 GMT, September notionnel futures were at 130.36, down eight basis points on the day.
"Yesterday we posted a 30 basis point gain...but I'm not convinced the move higher can be sustained," Dodgin said. "The resumption of the bull trend won't be confirmed until we move above 130.70."
The open and high on July 10 were at 130.70.
Technical analysts at Chase in London said resistance at 130.66 would have to be overcome to confirm that a corrective bottom was in place and to improve the near term outlook.
"Any initial pull back from the 130.60/66 resistance zone will test former trendline resistance...ahead of a cluster of trend and Elliott suppports at 130.31 to 130.29," they said.
They saw key near-term support at 130.24.
"Holding above here will be essential to maintain the current recovery trend," they said in a research note.
At the short end September Pibor futures were at 96.51, up one basis point on the day.
